title: papaver dubium f. ambiguum
intro: Papaver dubium f. ambiguum, commonly known as the yellow poppy, is a perennial plant species that belongs to the poppy family (Papaveraceae) and is native to Europe. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the potential health benefits of reducing inflammation and aiding in the relief of pain. The therapeutic actions of Papaver dubium f. ambiguum are attributed to its analgesic and anti-inflammatory properties, which may be attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids and alkaloids. However, more research is needed to confirm the exact bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
